labels: enhancement

---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that the tool does not support today? Describe the
situation, not just the missing feature.

## Proposed solution

How you would like it to work. Be concrete: what changes in the setup wizard,
the monitor, the config, or the sync behavior.

## Alternatives

Other approaches you considered, workarounds you are using now, or reasons an
obvious solution does not fit.
